verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has a dedicated versioning page stating that a new endpoint version is released for every backwards-incompatible change, and versioned endpoints exist (e.g., createTokenV3, with older integrations still supported and not required to migrate). The evidence shows no documented deprecation policy: no sunset timelines, notice periods or deprecation headers. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy with timelines/notice, sunset signaling for old versions, independent corroboration of version stability.
